name: Trinity
source:
Height: 40 cm to 200 cm.
An advisor who gives no advice.
A giant female cat from Wonderland which can use dimensional travel but becomes the size of a normal fat cat after using these powers. Even in her smaller form she is able to talk to people and use some of her magic.
